description: Grab an exclusive lease on a PR, issue, branch or file path in a repository you can write, for one of your agent sessions. Pass owner+repo with a bare key (PR/issue number, branch name, path), or target_id '<repository id>:<key>'. Returns lease null when another agent holds an active lease.

duration_ms.description: Lease duration, clamped to 1 second – 1 hour (default 5 minutes)

target_id.description: PR/issue number, branch name or file path (with owner+repo, or a session scoped to a repo); '<repository id>:<key>'; or a PR/issue id

name: gluecron_acquire_lease
